full_judgment: It is further held [in 11 DLR 445] that even if the donor had continued to possess the property as before living in the same house and used to receive rents, after the date of gift, will not invalidate the gift The presumption in such case being that the rents are collected by the husband on behalf of the wife and not on his own account.
